harness: native Codex app-server 0.162.1 with built-in tools and FACTORY board MCP
auth: ChatGPT subscription external access tokens; refresh remains on the host

nativeProof.basis: Read-only authoritative SQLite query matching current registered session UUIDs to native turn/started and commandExecution/mcpToolCall events

negativeControl.result: Messages must follow the machine/orchestrator communication policy.

nativeActions: native shell node version and git status
coldSdkLaunch.scope: Actual upstream API creation, configured persistent volume, bootstrap, private proxy and subscription native turn; diagnostic did not own FLUJO delivery

mission.result: Independent source reviews, focused tests, ownership coordination and failure diagnosis produced real receipts. Observed GitHub merges were performed by other owners; no swarm merge is attributed.
mission.fullWindowsLinuxQualification: The supervisor's exact-head PR1145 verify-local runs both stopped at the MarketplaceTab pagination-error regression. No full parity pass was recorded. Later external merges do not turn those failed checks into passes.

lessons.problem: Duplicating deployment and registry publication paths caused repeated Fly CLI/registry failures.
lessons.resolution: Import the existing flujo-cloud Machines API, immutable-image resolver and private proxy directly. The cold SDK launch required no custom image build or registry push.

lessons.problem: A standalone Codex binary lacked its mandatory code-mode-host and produced misleading turn completion.
lessons.resolution: Install both pinned, checksum-verified binaries and verify real native command/MCP item receipts for each session.

lessons.problem: Agent progress overwrote registered native UUIDs with aliases.
lessons.resolution: Register session identity through the trusted runtime/operator path; progress checkpoints cannot change it.

lessons.problem: Restarted trace files contained torn/NUL bytes and ACK loss.
lessons.resolution: Preserve damaged bytes, resume beyond receiver-confirmed sequence, fsync before delivery and reject replay with changed bytes. Missing events are not reconstructed or claimed.

lessons.problem: A completed native turn still had a retained turn id, so steering could block queued stop commands.
lessons.resolution: On the exact no-active-turn refusal, read authoritative thread state before starting the explicit message. New stop commands supersede older queued work with separate receipts.

lessons.problem: Collection selected only four directories and could miss independent test evidence or copy inconsistent SQLite files.
lessons.resolution: Snapshot all owned worker data, make SQLite backups, retain file-level hashes and verify downloaded archives. Stop acknowledgments precede collection.

lessons.problem: Fly exec returned HTTP408 while the original archive process continued copying; named per-machine NPM caches also inflated the snapshot.
lessons.resolution: Use durable detached collection jobs with observed original PIDs and completion receipts; do not relaunch after an observation timeout. Exclude dependency caches by their actual names. Stop models gracefully rather than freezing a process that may hold SQLite locks.

lessons.problem: Shared 2-CPU/4GB workers could run focused reviews but some FLUJO full build/typecheck attempts exhausted the default heap.
lessons.resolution: Record failed and incomplete gates precisely; configured resources and agent count do not imply unlimited concurrent heavy checks.

workerCostEstimate.assumptions: 10 continuously running shared-2CPU/4GB Machines in iad and ten provisioned 20GB volumes; 720-hour month; no Codex usage charge included; excludes traffic, snapshots and tax

limits: SDK-managed subordinate native sessions are not built-in Codex spawn_agent lineage.
Communication policy authenticates board identities; agents retain requested native shell access and are trusted.
Private histories, full raw traces, test evidence and provider journals are retained privately rather than committed publicly.
This is a real development acceptance run, not completed FLUJO production qualification.
